custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425624 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Have a special-order number that the test location received from vendor A on a special-order line of a work order within the last 12 months, and that is not an inventory part here.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425624 LINE S in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425624-SO in Part Number and pick Add new special order part, type a Description, 1 in Quantity, pick vendor A under Vendor and type a Cost, then click Save Part; order it and receive it from vendor A on the Receive screen (Purchase Orders in the left menu, Receive on its row, Vendor Invoice #, Invoice Date, Qty received, then the Receive Parts button).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425624 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Part Request" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The special-order number is offered as a result, and its source reads "Part Library · " followed by vendor A's name: the words Part Library, a middle dot, then the vendor.
  • No result says "Catalog".

Step 3:

  • The window closes, and work order 1's line shows no new part request.
